task: Implement a small contact-preferences form from fixtures/C04/brief.md. The intended Figma reference is deliberately unavailable in this simulated case; fixtures/C04/figma-access.json describes the fixture state, and there is no actual Figma file or URL to fetch. Do not attempt a real Figma lookup. Be explicit that visual fidelity to Figma cannot be verified, make reasonable design assumptions from the text brief, and continue with a useful implementation. The form has a labeled email field and Email updates, Product research and Partner offers checkboxes, with Save preferences and a visible saved summary. Use native TypeScript and CSS. Validate the email, let the user toggle the preferences by keyboard, and show save confirmation without a backend. Keep this to one small page. Include a concise handoff listing the design assumptions and what would need checking when Figma becomes available. Supply a runnable example and setup instructions, put implementation in trial/artifact and write trial/result.json using the supplied output contract.
